if_tampered.description: What to do when an ASAR integrity hash or ZIP CRC does not match.

max_depth.description: How deep nested archives are opened (0–6).

max_total_bytes.description: Most bytes read and hashed in total.

path.description: Absolute path of the archive, app bundle or folder. Defaults to the active target.

oneOf.description: Stop with an error when a recorded hash or checksum does not match the content.
Record mismatches as contradictions and keep going.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_archives_compare
definition.description: Compare two archives, app bundles or folders file by file: added, removed, changed (by sha256) and moved files. Inputs are absolute paths or core_archive_show evidence.

left.description: The older artifact: an absolute path, or core_archive_show evidence (inline or {"kind":"saved","evidence_id":...}).

right.description: The newer artifact, in the same forms.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_brief_write
definition.description: Set the investigation brief: the question, purpose, targets, constraints and what 'done' means. Write it before the first analysis call on a new question.

constraints.description: Constraints (clean room, no running the target, time budget...).

done_when.description: What a finished answer looks like.

purpose.description: Why the user is asking (interoperability, security review, learning...).

question.description: The question being answered, in one or two sentences.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_evidence_browse
definition.description: View part of a stored (or inline) evidence record: the summary, one part, one row of a list, a page of a list's rows (optionally only the rows matching given field values, cut to chosen fields, with the field names listed), or a part of a function dossier (pseudocode, assembly, basic_blocks, callers, callees, flow_*...), with coverage and next_offset. Nothing is analysed again.

show.description: What part of it to show.

oneOf.description: Evidence already recorded in this session or project.
A full evidence record passed inline.
The record without its result.
One named part of the result (e.g. mitigations, linkage).
One row of a list: by index, or the first whose name/address equals `pick`.
A page of a list (sections, symbols, functions...).

field_names.description: Also list the field names of the matching rows, to see what to match or pick.

fields.description: Return only these fields of each row (`a.b` reaches inside); a row without one leaves it out.

matching.description:
Keep only the rows whose fields equal these values, e.g. `{"kind": "require", "path":
["main.js", "preload.js"]}`: every field must match, a list means any of its values,
`a.b` reaches inside a row and null matches a field the row doesn't have.

offset.description: Counts matching rows when `matching` is given.

oneOf.description:
A part of a native function dossier (pseudocode, assembly, basic_blocks, callers, callees,
incoming_references, outgoing_references, unresolved_calls, referenced_strings,
referenced_names, native_api, flow_summary, flow_nodes,
flow_edges, flow_effects, flow_parameters, flow_parameter_uses,
comments, function). Text facets page by UTF-16 units.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_evidence_export
definition.description: Write every evidence record and unknown to a JSON bundle file.

path.description: Absolute path of the bundle file to write.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_evidence_exports_compare
definition.description: Compare two exported evidence bundles (core_evidence_export files) and report which records were added, removed or changed, matched by operation and subject. Every record is checked against its own id, so one edited after export is reported, never counted as unchanged.

keep_pairs.description: Include the matched record-id pairs in the result.

newer_bundle.description: Absolute path to the second evidence bundle.

older_bundle.description: Absolute path to the first evidence bundle.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_evidence_import
definition.description: Load a bundle written by core_evidence_export. Tampered records are rejected.

path.description: Absolute path of a bundle file.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_evidence_show
definition.description: All evidence recorded in this session (detail=summary for a compact list; filter by operation or evidence_id).

operation.description: Only records produced by this operation.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_feature_find
definition.description: Literal text → matching strings, functions and imports → the code that uses them → the functions involved.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

query.description: Text to look for (e.g. a label or message you see in the app).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_finding_edit
definition.description: Correct a recorded finding without changing its id. Requires a statement and existing evidence ids; pass based_on_revision to refuse a stale investigation update.

based_on_revision.description: The investigation revision read before editing; a stale revision is refused.

confidence.description: Omit to keep the finding's current confidence.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence ids that establish the corrected answer (at least one).

finding_id.description: An existing finding id from core_investigation_show.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_finding_record
definition.description: Record a settled answer. Requires at least one evidence id; every id is checked against the ledger. Findings are the source for reports.

confidence.description: observed (read directly), derived (computed from observations) or inferred (best guess).

evidence_ids.description: Evidence ids that establish it (at least one).

statement.description: The settled answer, in one or two sentences.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_handoff_write
definition.description: Rewrite the handoff note: where we are, what's next, traps to avoid. Write it at the end of every turn so the next turn (or agent) resumes without re-deriving.

text.description: Where we are, what's next, and traps to avoid. Replaces the previous handoff.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_hypothesis_record
definition.description: Record a claim being tested, ideally with the prediction that would confirm or refute it, plus any supporting/contradicting evidence ids.

prediction.description: What we expect to observe if the claim is true.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_hypothesis_update
definition.description: Change a hypothesis's status (testing/supported/refuted/abandoned) and attach supporting or contradicting evidence ids and notes.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_investigation_show
definition.description: The working memory of this investigation: brief, plan with step status, hypotheses, findings (with evidence ids) and the latest handoff. Read it first when starting or resuming.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_journal_read
definition.description: Page through the project's append-only journal (tool calls, model turns, consents, errors), filtered by day, kind or tool. Needs an open project.

day.description: Day to read (`YYYY-MM-DD`); the latest day when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_overview_show
definition.description: One-page summary of a program: format, architecture, entry, segments, counts of functions/strings/imports/exports, libraries, hardening, toolchain hints. detail=summary keeps the full record and returns counts plus a reference to page with core_evidence_browse.

detail.description:
complete (default) returns the full record; summary returns counts plus a reference to page
with core_evidence_browse.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

Detail.description:
The uniform summary-first detail control (see the module docs). `complete` is the default and
returns the full evidence record; `summary` returns a compact, pageable view.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_packed_files_list
definition.description: List the files carried inside one program or game file, recognised from its bytes (the reader used is in the result; `format` picks one when a file could be read several ways). Results give each member's path, size, how it's stored and what the file says it is, plus the facts of that kind of file, paged with offset/limit. `contains` keeps paths holding that text. For ordinary archives and app bundles use core_archive_show. Nothing is executed.

contains.description: Keep only members whose path contains this text.

format.description: Read the file as this kind (a reader id) instead of recognising it.

path.description: Absolute path of the file; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_packed_files_unpack
definition.description: Write files carried inside one program or game file into a new folder (output_directory must not exist yet; it is created). `paths` picks exact members, `contains` those holding some text; with neither, all of them. Never overwrites; a member whose path would leave the folder is skipped and named. Bounded by max_output_bytes and max_output_files. Writes manifest.json with every member's SHA-256 (under another name, given in the result, if a packed file took that one). Nothing is executed.

contains.description: Take out members whose path contains this text.

format.description: Read the file as this kind (a reader id) instead of recognising it.

output_directory.description: A folder that doesn't exist yet; its parent must.

path.description: Absolute path of the file; the active target when omitted.

paths.description: Exact member paths to take out.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_person_ask
definition.description: Ask the person a question in the app and wait for the answer: a short question, up to six suggested answers shown as buttons, and optionally a typed reply. Use it when a choice changes the result (scope, style, which feature first) and you can't decide from the evidence. Returns the answer text, or a note to continue with your best judgement if nobody answers within 30 minutes.

allow_text.description: Accept a typed answer too (default true).

choices.description: Up to six short suggested answers, best first.

context.description: One or two sentences of context shown under the question.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_plan_update
definition.description: Replace the plan with a numbered list of steps, each todo/doing/done/blocked with a short why. Pass based_on_revision to avoid overwriting someone else's update.

based_on_revision.description: The revision your change is based on (from core_investigation_show); omit to overwrite.

steps.description: The whole plan, in order (replaces the previous one).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_report_save
definition.description: Save a report a client composed (Markdown, HTML or plain text) to an absolute path the person chose. Only .md, .html, .htm or .txt files.

path.description: Where to save it: an absolute path ending in .md, .html, .htm or .txt.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_report_write
definition.description: Turn the investigation (brief, plan, findings, hypotheses, handoff) and the evidence ledger into a readable report: what we looked at, what we found (each finding with its plain-English summary, confidence and cited evidence), open questions, and how it was done. format=markdown (default) or html. With an absolute path it writes the file (WRITES_FILESYSTEM); otherwise it returns the text.

format.description: markdown (default) or html. HTML is a self-contained styled page.

include_evidence.description: Include the full evidence ledger as an appendix (default true). Findings always cite ids.

path.description: Absolute path to write the report to. When omitted the text is returned instead.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_session_show
definition.description: What's open, which target is active, Clean room or Deep mode, evidence and unknown counts, version.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_target_close
definition.description: Close the active target (or the one named). Evidence stays in the project.

target_id.description: Target to close; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_target_open
definition.description: Open a file, app bundle or folder as the active target. Detects what it is from its contents. For raw machine code pass format=raw-binary with architecture and entry_point.

architecture.description: Required with raw-binary: x86, x86_64, arm, arm64.

language_id.description:
Optional Deep-mode processor pin: a Ghidra language id such as `RISCV:LE:64:RV64GC`,
`PowerPC:BE:32:default`, `6502:LE:16:default`, `MIPS:BE:32:default` or `ARM:LE:32:v7`.
Takes effect only in Deep mode (Ghidra); it lets Deep target processors the built-in
clean-room engine doesn't cover, and overrides the `ghidra.language_id` setting for this
target. Ignored in Clean room.

path.description: Absolute path to a file, app bundle or folder.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_target_select
definition.description: Make another open target the active one.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_target_triage
definition.description: Say what a file is in plain English (format, OS, architecture, language/toolchain hints such as Go, Rust, .NET, Electron, Flutter, Delphi, packers) and which toolsets and tools to use next. Uses the active target unless path is given.

path.description: Absolute path of a file or folder; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_targets_list
definition.description: Every open target with its id, kind and sha256.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_unknown_add
definition.description: Record something not yet known, with what would settle it.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_unknown_edit
definition.description: Change an unknown's status, evidence or resolution. Pass based_on_revision; a stale revision gives stale_revision.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_unknown_verify
definition.description: Check that a resolved unknown has a resolution and cites evidence that exists and is intact.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__core_unknowns_show
definition.description: Recorded unknowns, filtered by status, severity or domain.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__db_sqlite_show
definition.description: Read a SQLite 3 database file without running any SQL: the header (page size, page count, text encoding, SQLite version that wrote it, WAL mode, freelist), the schema from sqlite_schema (tables, indexes, views and triggers with their CREATE statements and, for tables, parsed column names and types), per-table row counts (counted by walking the b-tree, bounded), and a page of rows from a named table (offset/limit; values as JSON; BLOBs shown as length plus a SHA-256 prefix, never dumped). Everything is bounded and read-only. Built-in parser (no SQLite library).

path.description: Absolute path of a .sqlite/.db file; the active target when omitted.

table.description: Read a page of rows from this table (by name, case-insensitive). Omit to list the schema only.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__engines_adb_check
definition.description: Report whether Android platform-tools (adb) is installed (Settings path, the managed engine store, then PATH) and its version. Contacts no device. Needs nothing installed to answer.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__engines_apktool_check
definition.description: Report whether Apktool is installed (Settings path, managed engine store, then PATH) and its version. Craft Anything's built-in resource and manifest decoders need nothing installed; Apktool is optional.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__engines_app_open
definition.description: Open Unity Hub or the Epic Games Launcher (to sign in and install the Unity Editor or Unreal Engine), found on this computer. Only those two; nothing else is started.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__engines_install
definition.description: Download and install an engine into Craft Anything's own folder: `ghidra` (Deep mode, with its Java), `godot`, or any engine with a pinned download (`adb`, `jadx`...). Every download is checked against its published SHA-256. Unity and Unreal need their vendors' installers and accounts: on Windows the installer (Unity Hub, the Epic Games Launcher) is downloaded, its publisher checked, and opened for the person; elsewhere they get the download page.

engine.description: `ghidra`, `godot`, `unity`, `unreal`, or an engine id from engines_list.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__engines_jeb_check
definition.description: Connect to the user-run JEB MCP server set in Settings → Engines (jeb_url, loopback only), report its server information, upstream tools and client information. Never starts JEB.

timeout_secs.description: Seconds to wait for the whole exchange (1..=600).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__engines_list
definition.description: What's on this computer: each external engine (where it was found, what it's for, whether it can be installed for you), Ghidra for Deep mode, and the game engines that can build games (Unity, Unreal, Godot, Rust) with whether each is ready.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__engines_tshark_check
definition.description: Check whether Wireshark's tshark is installed (Settings → Engines, the engine store, PATH, or the standard Wireshark folder) and which version it reports. Reads no capture. Optional: the built-in capture decoder works without it.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__firmware_image_extract
definition.description: Carve every recognised region of a firmware image into a new folder (output_directory must not exist yet), decompress gzip/zlib/xz/LZMA/bzip2/Zstandard streams, unpack ZIP, tar and cpio members and boot-image payloads, list and extract files from squashfs, cramfs, romfs, ext2/3/4 and (best-effort) JFFS2 filesystems, and repeat on what comes out up to max_depth levels. Bounded by max_output_bytes and max_output_files; never overwrites; members or filesystem paths that would escape the folder and links are refused. Writes manifest.json listing every output with its SHA-256 and how it was unpacked.

limit.description: Outputs listed in the evidence (the manifest always lists all of them; 1..=5000, default 500).

max_output_bytes.description: Most bytes written in total (up to 512 MiB, default 256 MiB).

output_directory.description: Absolute path of a folder that does not exist yet; it is created (its parent must exist).

path.description: Absolute path of the image; the active target when omitted.

range.description: Only extract from this part of the file.

length.description: Bytes in the range (cut to the end of the file).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__firmware_regions_list
definition.description: Signature scan of a firmware image or disk dump with the built-in engine: compression streams (gzip, zlib, xz, LZMA, bzip2, Zstandard, LZ4), archives (ZIP, tar, cpio, 7z, RAR, CAB), filesystems (squashfs, cramfs, romfs, JFFS2, UBI/UBIFS, ext2/3/4, FAT, ISO 9660), boot images (legacy boot-loader images, Android boot), device trees/FIT, executables (ELF, PE, Mach-O) and PEM blocks, each checked against its header; plus an entropy map, coverage, gaps and unexplained high-entropy spans. Regions are paged (offset/limit); range limits the scan to part of the file.

entropy_block.description: Entropy block size in bytes (256..=1048576, default 4096). Grows when the map would exceed 4096 blocks.

path.description: Absolute path of the image; the active target when omitted.

range.description: Only scan this part of the file (offsets stay relative to the whole file).

length.description: Bytes in the range (cut to the end of the file).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__formats_ai_weights_show
definition.description: Read an AI model file's header: GGUF (versions 2 and 3) or safetensors. Architecture, name, quantization, approximate parameter count, metadata keys and values (long values shortened), and tensors with their types and shapes, paged (offset/limit). Reads at most max_header_bytes from the start of the file, so very large models are fine; tensor data is never read. Uses the active target unless path is given.

max_header_bytes.description: Most bytes read from the start of the file (1 KiB..4 GiB, default 256 MiB).

path.description: Absolute path of the model file; the active target when omitted.

Detail.description:
The uniform summary-first detail control (see the module docs). `complete` is the default and
returns the full evidence record; `summary` returns a compact, pageable view.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__formats_bytecode_show
definition.description: Read a CPython compiled file (.pyc): the Python version from its magic number, how it ties to its source (modification time and size, or a source hash), and, for Python 3.8 to 3.14, its compiled code: each module, class and function with its name, dotted name, source file, first line, argument counts, the names it uses and the text among its constants, paged with offset/limit, parents before children. Other versions report the header and say why. python_version reads a file of bare marshalled code, such as a script taken out of a PyInstaller program. Built-in; nothing is executed and bytecode isn't decoded.

path.description: Absolute path of the file; the active target when omitted.

python_version.description: Treat the file as bare marshalled code with no header, compiled by this Python ("3.12").

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__formats_evm_interface_show
definition.description: Find the public function selectors in EVM contract bytecode (raw or hex, from a file or inline): where the dispatcher sends each selector, whether the function refuses payments (CALLVALUE check), fallback/receive presence, binary-search dispatch, and the compiler metadata (solc/vyper version, IPFS/Swarm hash). Function names are not recoverable without an ABI. Never executes the code.

bytecode.description: The bytecode as a hex string (optional 0x), instead of a file.

path.description: Absolute path of a file holding the bytecode; the active target when neither path nor bytecode is given.

oneOf.description: Hex when the content is only hex digits (optional 0x), raw bytes otherwise.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__formats_sbpf_disassemble
definition.description: Disassemble a range of eBPF / Solana sBPF bytecode into an instruction listing (address, mnemonic, operands, and resolved jump/call targets). Give a file (ELF with EM_BPF, or raw bytecode with encoding=raw) and an optional byte offset and length into the code. Built-in decoder; nothing is executed.

assume_version.description: Override the sBPF version (and the version for raw bytecode).

length.description: Bytes to disassemble from `offset` (default: to the end, capped).

offset.description: Byte offset into the code (the .text section for ELF, the file for raw). Default 0.

path.description: Absolute path of the program file; the active target when omitted.

oneOf.description: ELF when the file starts with the ELF magic, raw bytecode otherwise.
Force ELF parsing (machine type EM_BPF).
Treat the whole file as raw sBPF bytecode (no ELF, no sections or syscalls).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__formats_sbpf_show
definition.description: Inspect a Solana on-chain program or classic eBPF object (an ELF whose machine type is EM_BPF=247): the sBPF version (guessed from e_flags), sections (.text, .rodata, relocation tables), the dynamic symbol table, relocations with their R_BPF_* types, the syscalls it calls (resolved by the murmur3 hash of the helper name — sol_log_, sol_invoke_signed_*, ...), the entrypoint, discovered functions with basic blocks, and a paged disassembly listing with jump/call targets and a small pseudo form. Built-in decoder; nothing is executed. Honest limits: no account-model semantics and no Anchor IDL unless supplied separately.

assume_version.description: Override the sBPF version instead of the e_flags guess (and the version for raw bytecode).

offset.description: First instruction of the disassembly page.

path.description: Absolute path of the program file; the active target when omitted.

oneOf.description: Format, version, section/syscall/function counts and the entrypoint.
Everything, with the disassembly listing paged.
ELF when the file starts with the ELF magic, raw bytecode otherwise.
Force ELF parsing (machine type EM_BPF).
Treat the whole file as raw sBPF bytecode (no ELF, no sections or syscalls).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__formats_wasm_compare
definition.description: Compare the imports and exports of two WebAssembly modules (absolute paths): each import by module and name, each export by name, with its kind (func, table, memory, global, tag) and exact signature (function parameter/result types, memory and table limits, global type). Lists what was added, removed or changed, paged, with counts including unchanged entries; scope picks imports, exports or both. Static comparison only: matching signatures do not prove the modules behave the same.

left_path.description: Absolute path of the older (left) .wasm module.

right_path.description: Absolute path of the newer (right) .wasm module.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__formats_wasm_module_show
definition.description: Validate a WebAssembly module and list its sections, imports, exports, functions (signature, body size, name), memories, tables, globals, custom sections (names, producers, target features, source map URL), start function and data segments; optionally the text form (WAT), paged by characters; optionally scan JavaScript glue files for .wasm references and matching import names. Built-in parser.

include_wat.description: Include a page of the text form (WAT). Only valid modules are rendered.

js_glue_files.description: Up to 16 absolute paths of JavaScript glue files to scan for .wasm references and import names.

path.description: Absolute path of a .wasm file; the active target when omitted.

wat_offset.description: First character of the WAT page.

oneOf.description: Counts, validation, exports and producers.
Everything, with functions paged.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__frida_devices_find
definition.description: List devices Frida can see with `frida-ls-devices` (local, usb, remote). Pass remote to get one entry for a remote address without contacting it, so its reachability and auth are unverified (`frida-ps -H` checks it); its auth is forwarded to the CLI and never returned.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__frida_instrument_run
definition.description: Attach to (or spawn) a target, run a script for duration_ms (0..60000, default 1000), capture its output, and detach — all in one call. Executes foreign code, so it is consent-gated and destructive.

duration_ms.description: How long to run the script, in milliseconds (0..60000).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__frida_script_forget
definition.description: Forget a loaded script in a session (record-keeping; the bounded CLI run that executed it has already ended).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__frida_script_run
definition.description: Load and run an instrumentation script in a session for a bounded window, capturing its console/send output. source_kind=inline with source, or source_kind=file with an absolute path. Executing a script runs foreign code, so this is consent-gated and changes the target.

path.description: Absolute path to a script file (source_kind=file).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__frida_session_begin
definition.description: Begin a managed Frida session. mode=attach needs pid; mode=spawn needs program (absolute) and optional argv. Returns a session_id (held in memory) you pass to the other Frida tools. This records the session; code runs only when you load or resume a script.

argv.description: Extra arguments for a spawned program.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__frida_session_continue
definition.description: Resume a spawned, paused session so the target runs. Executes foreign code (the target's own), so this is consent-gated.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__frida_session_end
definition.description: End a managed session and forget it. Never kills the target process.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__frida_session_show
definition.description: Report a managed session's state, its device/target, and the scripts run in it with their most recent captured messages.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__frida_targets_list
definition.description: List processes and installed apps on the selected device with `frida-ps`. Give exactly one of device_id or remote.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__game_archives_list
definition.description: Find the packed files in a game's folder (absolute path): Unreal paks (.pak, checked by their footer) and IoStore containers (.utoc), Unity serialized files (.assets, level<n>, globalgamemanagers) and bundles (.bundle, data.unity3d), and Godot packs (.pck, or carried at the end of a program, checked by their mark, with how many files each declares), each with its size and the tool that lists it. Looks at most 8 folders deep and at 20000 entries.

path.description: Absolute path of the game's folder.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__game_iostore_list
definition.description: List what's inside an Unreal Engine IoStore container (absolute path of its .utoc table of contents, or of the .ucas beside it): its version, flags (compressed, encrypted, signed, indexed), compression methods, chunk and partition counts, and every named file with its size, stored size and compression, paged and optionally filtered by a part of the path. Unreal 5 games keep most of their assets this way. An encrypted container's names need the game's AES key, so they're counted, never guessed.

filter.description: Only files whose path contains this (any case).

path.description:
Absolute path of the archive (.pak, an IoStore container's .utoc or .ucas, a Unity .assets
or level file, or a Unity bundle).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__game_pak_extract
definition.description: Copy files out of an Unreal Engine .pak archive (absolute path). `file` is one file's path as game_pak_list shows it (any case) and `output` an absolute path that doesn't exist yet (its folders are made); the result has the size and SHA-256. A `file` ending in `/` (e.g. `Game/Content/UI/`) takes out every file under that folder into the folder `output`, keeping their layout, up to `limit` files per call: files already there are skipped, so calling again carries on. Stored and zlib-compressed files are supported and streamed. Encrypted files need the game's AES key and Oodle-compressed ones need Oodle (a commercial library the game ships), so both are refused with the reason.

file.description:
The file to take out, as game_pak_list shows it (e.g. `Game/Content/Maps/Level.umap`; any case),
or a folder ending in `/` (e.g. `Game/Content/UI/`) to take out every file under it.

limit.description: For a folder: the most files to take out in this call (at most 5000).

output.description:
Where to write it: an absolute path that doesn't exist yet (its folders are made). For a
folder, the folder to write into; files keep their layout under it.

path.description: Absolute path of the .pak file.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__game_pak_list
definition.description: List what's inside an Unreal Engine .pak archive (absolute path): its version (1-11), mount point, compression methods, and every file with its size, stored size, compression and whether it's encrypted, paged and optionally filtered by a part of the path. Only the footer and index are read, so very large paks are fine. An encrypted index is reported, never guessed: listing it needs the game's own AES key. Says when the game also keeps IoStore containers (.utoc/.ucas) beside it.

filter.description: Only files whose path contains this (any case).

path.description:
Absolute path of the archive (.pak, an IoStore container's .utoc or .ucas, a Unity .assets
or level file, or a Unity bundle).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__game_unity_asset_export
definition.description: Save one object of a Unity serialized file (absolute path of a .assets or level file, or of a bundle: then `file` picks the serialized file inside, the first by default) as a file anyone can open: a texture (Texture2D, by its path_id from game_unity_list) becomes a PNG at `output` (an absolute path that doesn't exist yet). Pixels are read inside the object or from the .resS file it streams from. Formats: Alpha8, R8, RGB24, RGBA32, ARGB32, BGRA32, RGB565, RGBA4444, ARGB4444, DXT1, DXT5, BC4, BC5, BC6H (tone-mapped to 8 bits; brighter than white clips) and BC7; others (crunched, ASTC, ETC...) are refused with their name. Unity 2017.3 and later.

file.description: For a bundle: the serialized file inside it (as game_unity_bundle_list shows); the first by default.

output.description: Where to write it: an absolute path that doesn't exist yet (its folders are made).

path.description: Absolute path of the .assets or level file, or of a bundle.

path_id.description: The object's path id (game_unity_list shows them).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__game_unity_bundle_list
definition.description: List the files inside a Unity asset bundle in the UnityFS format (absolute path: a .bundle, data.unity3d or Addressables file): its format, Unity version, block compression (LZMA, LZ4), and each file with its size, and for each serialized file inside, its Unity version, object count and objects by class. Only the blocks that hold those files' headers are decompressed. Paged and optionally filtered by a part of the path.

filter.description: Only files whose path contains this (any case).

path.description:
Absolute path of the archive (.pak, an IoStore container's .utoc or .ucas, a Unity .assets
or level file, or a Unity bundle).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__game_unity_code_names_show
definition.description: Read a Unity IL2CPP global-metadata.dat (path: the file, or a game's folder, where it's found under *_Data/il2cpp_data/Metadata or Data/il2cpp_data/Metadata): the metadata version, its assemblies (images) and how many types, methods, fields and string literals it names. view picks a list to page: images, types (namespace, name, assembly, method and field counts), methods (name, declaring type, parameter count) or strings (the string literals, each shown up to 4096 bytes); contains keeps rows holding that text (any case). Versions 24 (its later 264-byte-header form), 27, 29 and 31 are read, each only after the file proves it fits; other versions give their header and say so. Many games change or encrypt this file: that's stated plainly and nothing is decrypted or guessed. Only names are here, with no code or addresses.

contains.description: Keep only rows holding this text (any case).

offset.description: First matching row of the page.

path.description: Absolute path of global-metadata.dat, or of a game's folder to find it in.

view.description: What to list: summary (the default), images, types, methods or strings.

oneOf.description: Counts and the first page of images.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__game_unity_list
definition.description: List the objects in a Unity serialized file (absolute path: a .assets file, level<n>, globalgamemanagers, sharedassets<n>.assets in <Game>_Data) or in a bundle (.bundle, data.unity3d: every serialized file inside it, each object naming its `file`, or only `file`'s): the format version, Unity version, build platform, how many objects of each class (GameObject, Texture2D, AudioClip, MonoBehaviour...), the other files it points to, and the objects with their path id, class, size and name (named assets, GameObjects and MonoBehaviours), paged and optionally filtered by class or name. Unity 5 and later.

file.description: For a bundle: only this serialized file inside it (as game_unity_bundle_list shows); every one by default.

filter.description: Only objects whose class or name contains this (any case).

path.description: Absolute path of the .assets or level file, or of a bundle.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__game_unreal_texture_export
definition.description: Save a texture of an Unreal Engine 4.26-4.27 game as a PNG, only when the person confirms they may unpack the game (permission: true; they made it or its rights holder allows it). path is the game's .pak (then `file` is the texture's .uasset path inside it, as game_pak_list shows it) or a .uasset already taken out, with its .uexp (and .ubulk) beside it. The largest mip the game ships is saved at `output` (an absolute path that doesn't exist yet). Formats: B8G8R8A8, R8G8B8A8, G8, A8, DXT1, DXT5, BC4, BC5, BC6H (tone-mapped to 8 bits) and BC7; others (ASTC...) are refused by name, as are Oodle-compressed and encrypted paks, Unreal 5 packages and packages written without property names.

file.description: For a pak: the texture's .uasset path inside it, as game_pak_list shows it.

output.description: Where to write the PNG: an absolute path that doesn't exist yet (its folders are made).

path.description: Absolute path of the game's .pak, or of a .uasset already taken out (its .uexp and .ubulk beside it).

permission.description: The person made this game or has its rights holder's permission to unpack its files.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__harmony_app_graph_build
definition.description: Project a HarmonyOS package's inventory (core_archive_show evidence or a path) into an application graph: module manifests, HAP/HSP packages, Ark bytecode, native libraries by ABI and resources.

inventory.description: core_archive_show evidence (inline or retained). Its recorded path is re-read for the full inventory.

path.description: Or an absolute path to inventory now. Defaults to the active target when neither is given.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__java_archive_show
definition.description: Read a JAR or WAR with the built-in parser: the MANIFEST.MF attributes (main class, class-path, versions), the classes it defines grouped into a package tree, bundled dependencies (nested jars and native libraries), resources, and the class-file (Java) version(s) seen.

path.description: Absolute path of the JAR/WAR; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__java_class_show
definition.description: One class from a JAR/WAR or a bare .class: its Java version, access flags, superclass, interfaces, source file, annotations, inner classes, and its fields and methods with Java-style signatures. With decompile=true, also a pseudo-Java skeleton of the class.

decompile.description: Also include a pseudo-Java skeleton of the class (confidence Inferred).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__java_class_users_find
definition.description: Every instruction in every class of a JAR/WAR (or a single .class) that calls, reads, writes, creates or casts to a class (or only calls one of its methods when method_name is given), with the calling method and bytecode offset. Paged.

method_name.description: Only calls to methods with this name.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__java_classes_find
definition.description: Search the classes (and optionally methods) defined in a JAR/WAR or a single .class by name; an empty query lists every class. Paged (offset/limit).

query.description: Case-insensitive part of a class (or method) name. Empty lists every class.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__java_method_show
definition.description: A method's JVM bytecode as a disassembly listing with resolved constant-pool references (fields, methods, classes, string/number constants), branch targets, switch tables and the exception table, plus a best-effort structured pseudo-Java reconstruction (confidence Inferred). Paged over instructions.

descriptor.description: The method descriptor (`(I)I`) to pick a specific overload; the first match otherwise.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__java_vineflower_decompile
definition.description: Decompile a Java .class file or JAR (absolute path or the active target) to Java source with Vineflower, run as a program (its .jar with the configured Java, or a vineflower script; set its path in Settings → Engines). Without class: the decompiled source files with their line counts, paged with offset/limit (and the source itself when there is one file). With class (com.example.Foo or com/example/Foo): that class's source, paged by lines; inner classes are inside their outer class's file. Optional engine.

class.description: One class to show (com.example.Foo or com/example/Foo).

limit.description: Files or lines per page (1–20000, default 2000).

offset.description: First file (or, with class, first line) of the page.

path.description: Absolute path of a .class or .jar; omit to use the active target.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_app_map
definition.description: Static analysis of an Electron app (app.asar or unpacked folder), a web bundle folder, a ZIP or a single script into an application graph: package and entry points (main, preload, renderer), BrowserWindow webPreferences, the IPC channel map (ipcMain.handle/on ↔ ipcRenderer.invoke/send, contextBridge members), module imports, bundler and chunk splitting (webpack, esbuild, browserify; Vite/Rollup detected), routes, HTTP endpoints, storage, platform effects, native modules, vendors and source maps. Built-in parser; nothing is executed.

include_node_modules.description: Also parse code under node_modules (off: only their package.json files are read, as vendor facts).

input_path.description: Absolute path of an app.asar, an unpacked Electron app or web bundle folder, a ZIP, or one .js/.html file.

limit.description: Modules per page in the result (the graph itself is always complete up to max_nodes).

offset.description: First module of the module page in the result.

source_paths.description: Extra absolute files or folders to include (for example an `app.asar.unpacked` folder kept elsewhere).

oneOf.description: Detect from the path: folder, ASAR, ZIP or single file.
Stop when an ASAR integrity hash does not match its file.
Record the mismatch as a limitation and continue.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_electron_fuses_show
definition.description: Read the Electron fuse wire from a packaged Electron app without running it: pass the main executable (Windows .exe, Linux binary), the macOS .app bundle or Electron Framework binary, or the app's folder. Reports each wire's file offset, version and declared length, and every fuse by index with its name (RunAsNode, EnableCookieEncryption, EnableNodeOptionsEnvironmentVariable, EnableNodeCliInspectArguments, EnableEmbeddedAsarIntegrityValidation, OnlyLoadAppFromAsar, LoadBrowserProcessSpecificV8Snapshot, GrantFileProtocolExtraPrivileges, WasmTrapHandlers), state (enabled, disabled, removed), raw byte, what that state means for security, and whether it is the hardened setting. No sentinel means the fuse state is unknown.

path.description: Absolute path of the Electron executable, macOS .app bundle, Electron Framework binary or app folder; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_electron_page_show
definition.description: Passively inspect one Electron renderer page (a hostless file:// page) over CDP: frame origins, a DOM summary, parsed scripts (optionally their sources) and, opt-in, console entries. Never navigates or evaluates; values are never kept.

target_id.description: The renderer target id (from js_electron_pages_list); the first renderer otherwise.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_electron_pages_list
definition.description: List the debuggable targets of an Electron app started with --remote-debugging-port (loopback), labelling renderer pages (file:// or app:// URLs) and other targets. Attach-only discovery over HTTP.

cdp_endpoint.description: Loopback CDP endpoint of the Electron app (it must be started with --remote-debugging-port).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_electron_walkthrough_record
definition.description: Launch an Electron app's own executable with a private profile and a loopback debugging port, run a short script (wait / reload / navigate / click) against its first renderer, capture network request outlines, then terminate the owned process. Executes the app and accesses the network, so it needs your approval.

application_executable.description: Absolute path of the Electron app's executable to launch.

args.description: Extra arguments passed to the app after the debugging flags.

startup_secs.description: Seconds to wait for the app to start its debugging port.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_exports_compare
definition.description: Compare what each module exports (ES module names, CommonJS names, the kind of module.exports) between two application graphs, matching modules by path then by structure.

left.description: The older version: js_app_map evidence or an absolute path.

right.description: The newer version, in the same forms.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_function_explain
definition.description: Function-level slice of an application graph: for the seeded functions, their calls (resolved where possible), callers (resolved or same-name inferred), strings, the IPC/effects/endpoints/storage they touch, and a depth-limited callee tree. Unresolved dynamic calls are listed.

application.description: js_app_map evidence or an absolute path to analyse.

oneOf.description: Case-insensitive substring.

value.description: What to look for: a channel name, function name, string, module path, URL fragment or node id.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_runtime_code_match
definition.description: Match app graph evidence against what was seen running (captured scripts with URLs and sha256): each static module is loaded, resident in a loaded bundle, loaded with different content, not observed, or unknown; runtime-only scripts are listed. Pure computation over evidence.

runtime_evidence.description: Runtime evidence that lists scripts (objects with `url` and `sha256`), inline or retained.

static_evidence.description: The static side: one or more application graphs.

evidence.description: js_app_map evidence (inline or {"kind":"saved","evidence_id":...}) or an absolute path.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_runtime_watch
definition.description: Attach the V8 inspector to one Node/Electron target and observe passively: it sends exactly Runtime.enable and Debugger.enable, then records the scripts parsed (deduplicated and sorted), execution contexts and a parse-failure count. Never resumes a paused (--inspect-brk) target. runtime_kind is taken as given.

runtime_kind.description: The kind of runtime, as given (not checked).

target_id.description: The target id to observe (from js_runtimes_list); the first otherwise.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_runtimes_list
definition.description: List the inspectable targets of a Node or Electron process started with --inspect (loopback V8 inspector endpoint), with their ids and whether another client is attached. Attach-only discovery.

cdp_endpoint.description: Loopback V8 inspector endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9229 (node --inspect=127.0.0.1:9229).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_source_bundle_compare
definition.description: Match reference source files (from app_source_import, or a folder path) to the shipped app's files and bundle modules by path, source-map listing, shared strings, function names and export names; reports matches with scores and reasons, unmatched sources and bundle code without a source.

application.description: js_app_map evidence or an absolute path to analyse.

source.description: app_source_import evidence (inline or retained) or an absolute source folder path.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_source_locate
definition.description: Map a position in generated (bundled/minified) JavaScript back to its original file, line, column and name through a source map (a .map file, a script's sourceMappingURL, or an inline data: map). Lines are 1-based, columns 0-based UTF-16. Returns every original position at that point and nearby original source when the map embeds it.

context_lines.description: Original-source lines of context around each hit.

script_path.description: Or the generated script: its sourceMappingURL (a sibling file or an inline data: URL) is followed.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__js_sources_restore
definition.description: Turn minified bundles back into readable files in a new folder: split webpack/esbuild/browserify module tables into one file per module, pretty-print everything, apply safe unminify rewrites (!0→true, void 0→undefined, statement sequences, webpack module parameter names via scope analysis) and write original files embedded in source maps. manifest.json records every input digest, module byte range and output file.

additional_paths.description: Up to 16 more scripts or folders.

limit.description: Output files listed per page in the result.

output_directory.description: Absolute path of a folder that does not exist yet.

path.description: Absolute path of a script or a folder of scripts.

oneOf.description: Split only recognised bundle module tables; pretty-print everything; write source-map originals.
Pretty-print only (no splitting, no source-map originals).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__managed_app_graph_build
definition.description: Project a .NET assembly (managed evidence or a path) into an application graph: assembly, referenced assemblies, types, methods, external members, native modules and resources, joined by contains, references, inherits, calls and pinvoke edges. Bounded by max_nodes.

input.description: Managed evidence (managed_assembly_show, managed_members_list or managed_native_calls_list) or an absolute path; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__managed_assemblies_compare
definition.description: Compare the members of two assemblies (managed_members_list evidence or absolute paths) with tiered unique matching: identical IL and signature (survives renames), then type+name+signature, then the same structure. Reports unchanged, changed (body differs), renamed or moved, added, removed and ambiguous methods, plus added/removed types and fields.

left.description: The older build: managed_members_list evidence (inline, {"kind":"saved","evidence_id":...} or an id) or an absolute path.

right.description: The newer build, in the same forms.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__managed_assembly_show
definition.description: Built-in ECMA-335 reader: PE/CLI header (runtime version, IL-only/32-bit/strong-name flags, entry point, ReadyToRun), metadata streams and table row counts, assembly identity, assembly and module references, manifest resources, forwarded types, assembly attributes (TargetFramework decoded) and a classification (runtime family, implementation, managed architecture). Uses the active target unless path is given.

path.description: Absolute path of a .NET assembly (.dll/.exe); the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__managed_ilspy_decompile
definition.description: Decompile a .NET assembly (absolute path or the active target) with the installed ILSpy command line (ilspycmd): operation decompile gives C# for the whole assembly, or for one type with type_name (`Namespace.Type`, nested types as `Outer+Inner`); il gives the whole assembly's IL; list_types lists its classes, interfaces, structs, delegates and enums. Its update check is turned off, so it never goes online. Returns the raw text paged by lines. Optional engine: the built-in .NET tools need nothing installed.

offset.description: First output line of the page.

path.description: Absolute path of the assembly; the active target when omitted.

type_name.description: For decompile: one fully qualified type (`Namespace.Type`, nested as `Outer+Inner`).

oneOf.description: C# source.
The IL, for the whole assembly.
Every class, interface, struct, delegate and enum, one per line.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__managed_members_list
definition.description: Types, fields, properties, events and methods of a .NET assembly with C#-like signatures; for each IL method body: header kind, max stack, locals, exception clauses, IL size, il_hash, an il_shape_hash that survives renames, call targets, field accesses and string literals (optionally the IL listing). Filter with type_names; paged by type (offset/limit).

path.description: Absolute path of a .NET assembly; the active target when omitted.

type_names.description: Only these types (full name like `Ns.Type`, nested as `Ns.Outer/Inner`, or simple name).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__managed_native_calls_list
definition.description: Where a .NET assembly crosses into native code: P/Invoke (DllImport) rows with module, entry point, charset, calling convention, SetLastError, best-fit and PreserveSig; internal calls; native-code (mixed-mode) and runtime-implemented methods; UnmanagedCallersOnly and LibraryImport declarations; module references and vtable fixups.

path.description: Absolute path of a .NET assembly (.dll/.exe); the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__managed_native_calls_verify
definition.description: Check each P/Invoke of a managed assembly (managed_native_calls_list evidence or a path) against the exports of native libraries (native_layout_show evidence or absolute paths): found, found as an A/W or stdcall-decorated variant, case mismatch, missing, or undetermined when the module wasn't supplied.

managed.description: The managed side: managed_native_calls_list evidence or an absolute assembly path.

native.description: Native libraries: native_layout_show evidence or absolute paths (ELF, PE or Mach-O).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__managed_reconstruction_check
definition.description: Check user-supplied C# (a file, a folder of .cs files, or text) against the assembly's member evidence: declarations matched, signature mismatches, members missing from the source, extra source members, compiler-implicit members, and missing/extra types. Declarations only, not behaviour.

max_files.description: Most .cs files read from a folder.

members.description: The assembly: managed_members_list evidence or an absolute path.

source_path.description: Absolute path of a .cs file or a folder of .cs files.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_address_offset_show
definition.description: Map a virtual address to its offset in the original file (and the section holding it).

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_address_show
definition.description: The name, containing function, comment, inline comment and bookmarks at one address in the active target. Each facet is a value or a clear 'unavailable' with a reason.

document.description: Target id or name; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_api_show
definition.description: The system and library APIs a function calls, grouped by purpose (files, network, processes, crypto...), plus internal calls, indirect calls and jump tables.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_bookmark_add
definition.description: Bookmark an address with an optional name.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

name.description: Bookmark label.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_bookmark_remove
definition.description: Remove the bookmark at an address.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_bookmarks_show
definition.description: Bookmarks you or an agent set on the active target.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_bytes_find
definition.description: Find every place a byte signature or a piece of text occurs in a file (an absolute path, or the active target). `pattern` is hex byte pairs with `??` for any byte (spaces optional, e.g. `48 8B ?? 24`); `text` is searched as UTF-8 and/or UTF-16LE. Matches are ordered by file offset and paged (offset/limit); for ELF, PE and Mach-O programs each match also carries its virtual address and containing section when the bytes are mapped. Overlapping matches are all reported. Counting stops at 100000 matches.

document.description: Open document (id or name) to search instead of the active one; ignored with path.

encoding.description: How `text` is encoded in the file: utf8, utf16le or both (default).

path.description: Absolute path of the file to search; the active target when omitted.

pattern.description: Hex byte pairs with `??` wildcards, e.g. "48 8B ?? 24 ?? 00".

oneOf.description: Both UTF-8 and UTF-16LE (default).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_bytes_show
definition.description: Bytes at a virtual address as hex (default 256, at most 65536), never past the end of the section.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_call_graph_show
definition.description: Callees (forward) or callers (backward) of a function, level by level, with edges and honest truncation.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_call_path_find
definition.description: Shortest direct-call path from one function to another (forward or backward), with goal status and residual unknowns. Forward, the goal may also be an import (e.g. CreateWindowExW): the path ends at the call to it.

direction.description: forward (start calls ... goal, default) or backward (goal is reached from start's callers).

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

goal.description:
Goal function (name or address), or an import's name when tracing forward; without it,
everything reachable is listed.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_call_site_resolve
definition.description: Resolve the target(s) of one call or jump site: direct target, import, jump-table candidates, or unresolved.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_comment_read
definition.description: The comment at an address, or null.

address.description: Virtual address (0x-hex); the cursor when omitted.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_comment_write
definition.description: Set the comment at an address (empty clears it) and read it back.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_crash_show
definition.description: Read a Linux ELF core dump: the signal and its meaning, the faulting address, registers of each thread, the process name and arguments, mapped files, and which file the crash happened in.

path.description: Absolute path of an ELF core file; the active target when omitted.

with_debugger_context.description: Ask for live debugger context (not available in clean-room mode; reported as a limitation).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_cursor_address_show
definition.description: The cursor address in the active document (set with native_cursor_goto or in the app).

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_cursor_back
definition.description: The address of the previous instruction (in code) or previous byte (in data) before an address (the cursor by default). Doesn't move the cursor.

address.description: Virtual address (0x-hex); the cursor when omitted.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_cursor_forward
definition.description: The address of the next instruction (in code) or next byte (in data) after an address (the cursor by default). Doesn't move the cursor.

address.description: Virtual address (0x-hex); the cursor when omitted.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_cursor_function_show
definition.description: The function containing the cursor.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_cursor_goto
definition.description: Move the cursor to an address (must be mapped in the program).

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_cursor_show
definition.description: The current cursor address in the active target.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_cutter_command_run
definition.description: Run one read-only Rizin command in a shared Cutter session (port, default 9090) and return its text, paged by lines: information (i...), printing and disassembly (p..., x...), analysis (a...), search (/...), seek (s...), flags (f...), comments (C...), types (t...) and help (?...). Writes, shell escapes, scripts, debugging, pipes and chaining are refused. Analysis and seek commands change what the Cutter window shows, as if typed in its console.

command.description: One read-only Rizin command, for example `afl`, `pdf @ main` or `iz`.

offset.description: First output line of the page.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_cutter_sessions_list
definition.description: Find Cutter (or Rizin) sessions shared on this computer: each port given (default 9090) is asked what it has open (file, format, architecture). A session is shared by running `=h& 9090` in Cutter's console; nothing else is reachable.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_data_show
definition.description: Best-effort typing of data at an address: string, pointer (to a function, string or data), pointer table, integer, or a requested type (u8...u64, i32, i64, f32, f64, pointer, cstring, utf16).

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

type.description: Type to read it as: u8, u16, u32, u64, i32, i64, f32, f64, pointer, cstring, utf16. Inferred when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_document_show
definition.description: The active document (open target).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_dos_image_show
definition.description: Check a DOS MZ or .COM program's load image: header, SHA-256 digests (file, header, load module), relocations, entry point and stack, with any inconsistencies.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_address_show
definition.description: Resolve a function name to its canonical entry address.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address (0x-hex; any address inside it works).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_callees_list
definition.description: Direct callees of a function, with resolved names and imports.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address (0x-hex; any address inside it works).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_callers_list
definition.description: Call sites that call (or tail-jump to) this function.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address (0x-hex; any address inside it works).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_disassemble
definition.description: The function's assembly as one text listing (address, bytes, instruction, names).

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address (0x-hex; any address inside it works).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_find
definition.description: The function whose code contains an address.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_instructions_list
definition.description: Every instruction of a function with bytes, mnemonic, operands, flow and referenced addresses.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address (0x-hex; any address inside it works).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_label
definition.description: Rename a function and/or set its entry comment and inline comment in one step (empty strings clear), read them back, and return the refreshed function facts.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address.

inline_comment.description: Inline comment at the entry (empty clears).

name.description: New name (empty clears your name).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_pseudocode
definition.description: Structured pseudo-C from the built-in clean-room lifter: register-level variables, if/else and loops from the control-flow graph, resolved call names, inline string literals. Honest about its limits.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address (0x-hex; any address inside it works).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_references_list
definition.description: Raw reference edges of a function: incoming (to its entry) or outgoing (from its code).

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_show
definition.description: Entry, end, size, basic blocks, body ranges, call counts, jump tables and how the function was found.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address (0x-hex; any address inside it works).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_function_study
definition.description: Everything about one function in one record: facts, pseudo-C, assembly, basic blocks, callers, callees, references, strings, unresolved calls, API boundary and register value flow. Page through big facets with core_evidence_browse; detail=summary returns counts plus a reference first.

detail.description:
complete (default) returns the full dossier; summary returns counts plus a reference to page
big facets (assembly, callers...) with core_evidence_browse.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

function.description: Function name or address.

Detail.description:
The uniform summary-first detail control (see the module docs). `complete` is the default and
returns the full evidence record; `summary` returns a compact, pageable view.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_functions_decompile
definition.description: Pseudo-C for several functions at once (up to 64); each item succeeds or fails on its own.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_functions_list
definition.description: Every function the built-in engine found: entry, name, size, blocks, how it was found. Paged (offset/limit).

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_functions_search
definition.description: Complete, deterministic search of function names (yours and the engine's) and imports (kind "import", e.g. CreateWindowExW). mode literal or regex; case-insensitive unless case_sensitive. Paged.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

pattern.description: What to look for.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_gdb_command_run
definition.description: Run one GDB command line in a session (for example `info functions`, `disassemble main`, `break main`, `run`, `bt`, `info registers`, `x/16xb $sp`) and return its console output, the result (done, running, error, exit), stop events (reason, frame) and any program output, waiting up to timeout_seconds for a started run to stop. Commands can run the program, call its functions or use GDB's shell and Python, so this asks for consent.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the command (and a started run) to finish: 1–300, default 10.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_gdb_session_begin
definition.description: Start GDB (machine-interface mode, no init files, auto-loaded scripts off, pagination off) with a program loaded (absolute path; optional core file and program arguments), or empty. The program is only loaded, not run. Returns a session_id for native_gdb_command_run, native_gdb_session_show and native_gdb_session_end, plus GDB's start-up messages. Sessions live in memory for this run; at most 4 at a time.

args.description: Arguments the program gets when it is run.

core.description: Absolute path of a core dump to open with the program.

program.description: Absolute path of the program to load; omit for an empty session.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_gdb_session_end
definition.description: End a GDB session: ask GDB to exit, then stop it and anything it started (including a program it is debugging).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_gdb_session_show
definition.description: Show one GDB session (or all when session_id is omitted): whether GDB is alive, the last known program state (not started, stopped, running, exited), the last stop event, and any output that arrived since the last command.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_go_binary_show
definition.description: Read a Go program (ELF, PE or Mach-O; pick a universal-binary slice with architecture): the build information block (Go version, main module, dependencies with versions, sums and replacements, build settings such as -ldflags, CGO_ENABLED, GOOS/GOARCH, vcs.revision) and the function name table (pclntab, Go 1.2–1.20+ layouts) with every function's name and entry address, paged, plus functions per package. Built-in parser.

architecture.description: For a universal (fat) Mach-O: the slice to read (x86_64, arm64...). The first slice otherwise.

include_functions.description: Include the function list page (default true).

path.description: Absolute path of an ELF, PE or Mach-O file; the active target when omitted.

query.description: Only functions whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_inline_comment_read
definition.description: The inline comment at an address, or null.

address.description: Virtual address (0x-hex); the cursor when omitted.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_inline_comment_write
definition.description: Set the inline (end-of-line) comment at an address (empty clears it) and read it back.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_instruction_show
definition.description: The instruction (or data) at an address: operands, flow, registers read and written, references, containing function.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_layout_show
definition.description: Sections, segments (ELF program headers), symbols, relocations, linkage and hardening (NX, PIE, RELRO, canary, fortify, CFG...) of an ELF, PE or Mach-O file. detail=summary returns counts and keeps the complete record in the session.

path.description: Absolute path of an ELF, PE or Mach-O file; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_library_calls_list
definition.description: The functions a program takes from other libraries, without analysing it. Windows programs: the import directory, the delay-load directory and bound imports, by name (with hint) or by ordinal, each saying which kind it is. ELF: the dynamic symbols with their needed version and library. Mach-O: bound symbols with how each library is linked. Libraries are summarised first, then rows are paged (offset/limit); contains keeps rows whose name or library holds that text, kind keeps one kind. Uses the active target unless path is given.

contains.description: Keep rows whose name or library holds this text (any case).

kind.description: Keep one kind: normal, delay, dynamic, weak, load, reexport, lazy, upward.

path.description: Absolute path of the program; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_name_set
definition.description: Give an address a name (an empty name clears yours). Names show everywhere: listings, assembly, pseudo-C, call graphs. Saved with the project.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

name.description: New name; empty clears your name.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_name_show
definition.description: The primary name at an address (your name first), or null.

address.description: Virtual address (0x-hex); the cursor when omitted.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_name_xrefs_list
definition.description: Exact name (function, data symbol or import) → its address and every reference to it. Gives reason name_not_found when nothing has that name.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

name.description: Exact name of a function, data symbol or import.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_named_addresses_list
definition.description: Named addresses: your names, functions, data symbols and import slots. Optional single-address filter. Paged.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_names_set
definition.description: Name several addresses at once; reports success per address.

document.description: Open target (document) to use; the active one when omitted.

names.description: Map of address (0x-hex) → name; empty names clear.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_objdump_run
definition.description: Run the installed objdump (GNU binutils or llvm-objdump) for one operation on a file (absolute path or the active target): file_headers, private_headers, section_headers, symbols, dynamic_symbols, relocations, dwarf (GNU only; debuginfod disabled), disassemble or disassemble_all (optionally between start_address and stop_address), or architectures (no file needed). Returns the raw text paged by lines, with the exit status and stderr. Optional engine: the built-in disassembler needs nothing installed.

offset.description: First output line of the page.

path.description: Absolute path of the file; the active target when omitted (not used for architectures).

stop_address.description: For disassembly: address to stop before (0x-hex).

oneOf.description: The targets and architectures this objdump supports; no file needed.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_offered_symbols_list
definition.description: The functions and data a program or library offers to others, without analysing it. Windows: the export directory with ordinals, names, ordinal-only entries and forwarders to other libraries. ELF: exported dynamic symbols with their versions. Mach-O: the export list. Paged (offset/limit); contains keeps rows whose name or forwarder holds that text. Uses the active target unless path is given.

contains.description: Keep rows whose name or forwarder holds this text (any case).

path.description: Absolute path of the program or library; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_open_documents_list
definition.description: Open targets (documents) with ids, kinds and which one is active.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_pe_resources_list
definition.description: PE32/PE32+ resource tree (type → name → language) with SHA-256 of each item, icon groups, version information and the manifest. Built-in parser. Uses the active target unless path is given.

max_file_bytes.description: Refuse files bigger than this (64 MiB..512 MiB, default 64 MiB).

path.description: Absolute path of a PE file; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_publisher_show
definition.description: Read a Windows program's Authenticode signature block: each certificate table entry, the signer's subject, issuer, serial and validity dates, every embedded certificate, and the digest algorithm. Checks what the file alone can show: its hash against the signed hash, the signature against the embedded signer certificate, and how the embedded certificates link. Doesn't check whether Windows trusts them, revocation, expiry against any date, or catalog signing, and lists timestamps and nested signatures without reading them. Uses the active target unless path is given.

path.description: Absolute path of the Windows program; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_rizin_command_run
definition.description: Run one read-only Rizin command against a file (absolute path or the active target) with user settings and scripts disabled (`rizin -N -q -c <command> <file>`; the file is opened read-only). Commands are checked against an allow-list of read-only families: information (i...), printing and disassembly (p..., x...), analysis (a...), search (/...), seek (s...), flags (f...), comments (C...), types (t...) and help (?...). Shell escapes, writes, file opening, debugging, scripts, configuration changes, pipes, redirects and command chaining are refused. Returns the raw text paged by lines. Optional engine.

analyze.description: Run `aa` (basic analysis) first, for commands that need functions.

command.description: One read-only Rizin command, e.g. "iI", "iS", "afl", "pdf @ main", "izz~http".

offset.description: First output line of the page.

path.description: Absolute path of the file; the active target when omitted.

definition.name: mcp__craft-anything__native_rizin_session_begin
definition.description: Start Rizin's debugger (user settings and scripts off, no prompt or colours) on a program (absolute path, optional arguments), which it starts stopped before its first instruction, or attach it to a running process by pid. Returns a session_id for native_rizin_session_command_run, native_rizin_session_show and native_rizin_session_end, plus Rizin's start-up messages. The program's own console output isn't captured. Sessions live in memory for this run; at most 4 at a time. Starting a program or attaching to one asks for consent.
